audit_phase: Phase 5C — Independent Non-Flare Label Expansion & Match Audit

circular_sources_rejected.source: Forest Survey of India (FSI) Van Agni Alerts
circular_sources_rejected.reason: Direct derivative of SNPP-VIIRS and MODIS active fire hotspots. Satellite circularity violation.
Direct derivative of VIIRS/MODIS hotspots masked by agricultural land cover. Circularity violation.

inaccessible_sources_rejected.reason: Non-machine-readable paper records; lack geocoded vector perimeters and sub-day timestamps.

geographically_disjoint_tier1_sources.status: Verified Tier 1 Ground Truth, but geographically restricted to US landmass.
Verified Tier 1 Ground Truth, but geographically restricted to Canada landmass.

regional_non_flare_observations_audited.agricultural_burn_justification: STRICT PROHIBITION ENFORCED: No non-satellite farm dispatch or burning permit records exist for these coordinates. Inferring AGRICULTURAL_BURN from cropland land cover + harvest season is an unverified heuristic, not ground truth.
regional_non_flare_observations_audited.wildfire_justification: STRICT PROHIBITION ENFORCED: No non-circular wildland fire incident dispatch perimeters exist for these coordinates. Inferring WILDFIRE from vegetation land cover is an unverified heuristic.
regional_non_flare_observations_audited.negative_control_justification: Labeling unmatched hotspots as 'OTHER' or 'CONTROL' would be false. Unmatched means no verified external label was found; it does NOT mean the thermal emitter was definitively not vegetation or agricultural burning.

recommended_taxonomy_revision.rationale: Satellite sensors and burned area products (MCD64A1) observe the physical combustion of vegetative biomass, but cannot observe human legal intent. Merging agricultural residue and open scrub burning into a unified, physically defensible VEGETATION_BURN class avoids unsupportable claims regarding human fire ignition type, while reserving WILDFIRE_INCIDENT_CONFIRMED strictly for Tier 1 agency dispatch perimeters (e.g. WFIGS).

supervised_learning_readiness_test.justification: The active corpus contains only one verified training class (GAS_FLARE, N = 155). Mathematical optimization of supervised classification requires at least two distinct labeled classes. Model training cannot proceed until complementary geographic regions with verified Tier 1/Tier 2 non-flare labels (e.g. US NIFC WFIGS or Canadian CNFDB) are ingested.
